title: Share this entry with Nora
body:
Share this journal entry with Nora, the PulseCheck AI, for a reply. This personal Nora choice does not permit the entry to be exported in Athletic Mind partner snapshots. Saving an entry and its safety check are separate from this choice.

Your entry is private from coaches, trainers, parents, and team clinicians unless you authorize a separate sharing action. Necessary emergency concern information follows the applicable configured safety pathway. You can stop sharing, and editing requires sharing the updated entry again. A preference for new entries applies only to entries saved afterward.
